statement: The function returns a result ans and ans is the maximum, over all choice functions c : {0,...,n-1} -> {0,1} and all index pairs l,u with 0 <= l <= u < n, of the length u-l+1 subject to the condition that, writing v_i = nums1[i] if c(i)=0 and v_i = nums2[i] if c(i)=1, one has v_j <= v_{j+1} for every j with l <= j < u. In other words, ans is the largest achievable length of a contiguous non-empty subarray of some nums3 obtained by choosing at each index one of the two given values.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Assume len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums1[i] <= 10^9 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result ans and does not fail (no overflow, panic, or out-of-bounds failure).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Assume len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums1[i] <= 10^9 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans, 1 <= ans <= n.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Assume len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums1[i] <= 10^9 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result ans and ans = n.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Assume len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums1[i] <= 10^9 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 10^9. Assume also that either nums1 is non-decreasing, meaning nums1[i] <= nums1[i+1] for every i with 0 <= i < n-1, or nums2 is non-decreasing, meaning nums2[i] <= nums2[i+1] for every i with 0 <= i < n-1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans, for every choice function c : {0,...,n-1} -> {0,1} and every l,u with 0 <= l <= u < n, writing v_i = nums1[i] if c(i)=0 and v_i = nums2[i] if c(i)=1, if v_j <= v_{j+1} for every j with l <= j < u, then u-l+1 <= ans.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Assume len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums1[i] <= 10^9 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result ans and there exist a choice function c : {0,...,n-1} -> {0,1} and indices l,u with 0 <= l <= u < n such that u-l+1 = ans and, writing v_i = nums1[i] if c(i)=0 and v_i = nums2[i] if c(i)=1, one has v_j <= v_{j+1} for every j with l <= j < u.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Assume len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums1[i] <= 10^9 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 10^9.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result ans on the argument pair (nums1,nums2) and a result ans_swapped on the argument pair (nums2,nums1), and ans = ans_swapped.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Assume len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums1[i] <= 10^9 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Let a1 and a2 be the length-n arrays defined by a1[k] = nums2[k], a2[k] = nums1[k], and a1[i] = nums1[i] and a2[i] = nums2[i] for every i with 0 <= i < n and i != k. The function returns a result ans on (nums1,nums2) and a result ans_swapped_index on (a1,a2), and ans = ans_swapped_index.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Assume len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums1[i] <= 10^9 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 10^9. Fix an index k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans, ans = 1 if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < n-1, min(nums1[i], nums2[i]) > max(nums1[i+1], nums2[i+1]), where min and max are the ordinary integer minimum and maximum.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Assume len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n, n >= 2, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums1[i] <= 10^9 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans, ans = n if and only if there exists a choice function c : {0,...,n-1} -> {0,1} such that, writing v_i = nums1[i] if c(i)=0 and v_i = nums2[i] if c(i)=1, the inequalities v_i <= v_{i+1} hold for every i with 0 <= i < n-1.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums1). Assume len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums1[i] <= 10^9 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 10^9.
